issue.title: Keep inbox forced-check test assumes UTC when the notice uses local time
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-f5.1 #1, bob-cli-f5.2 #1, bob-cli-f5.3 #1, and bob-cli-f5.4 #1; triaged by bob-cli-f5.land.

On clean bob-plugins 32c9e03248a03c1570f4dea6a29e7c8f6c15f130, scripts/test-ledger-tools-keep-inbox.cjs::forced check feedback follows the bob refresh result fails the rate-limited case in America/New_York: actual notice ends 12:30, expected 16:30. The fixture next_check_at is 2026-10-31T16:30:00Z, while production intentionally presents local time. The assertion hardcodes UTC. The entire file passes 33/33 with TZ=UTC on the unchanged tree. This is deterministic timezone dependence, not intermittent behavior under fixed TZ.

Root cause is the test at roughly lines 1020-1041, introduced before f5. No code in this file changed in a67b8cd^..32c9e03. Fix the test clock/timezone expectation deterministically and retain local-time production behavior. Verify at least UTC and America/New_York, keeping the substantive success/floor/backoff/busy cases. Small: one known test fixture mismatch; no production redesign.

Same-type/all-type searches and last-week task sweeps found no duplicate. bob-cli-et is a different real-date dependency in two other tests; bob-cli-eh is a different onLayoutReady fake problem. None of the 12 active epics caused this pre-existing Keep test defect.

Evidence: focused failures file:explicit:3f28f3367c36f04929e7f6a0; UTC control file:explicit:bb831eb0037472bbaee6798e.
